name: Pearl na Kibun de ~Ashita ni Mukatte Arukou~
original_name: パールな気分で～明日に向かって歩こう～
source:
Main character works for a top company in the mids of recession. He's desperate to increase sales. But after work he has meetings with 40 beautiful girls. Working hard doubles his charm! He wants to get both work and love!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在经济衰退期间为一家顶尖公司工作，拼命提高销售额。但下班后，他还要与40位美女见面。努力工作能让魅力翻倍！他想事业爱情双丰收！

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
